summary: This class discusses when to say Tashlikh on Rosh Hashanah, addressing questions about timing on the first day, the second day, and when Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbat. It covers the reasoning based on the Gemarah and Midrash concerning Adam HaRishon, and explores community customs from various places.
questions: When is the proper time to say Tashlikh on Rosh Hashanah?
Should Tashlikh be said when the first day of Rosh Hashanah falls on Shabbat?
What should someone do if they are in an area without an Eruv on Shabbat?
Why is late in the day considered the best time for Tashlikh?
